rules: Append-only. Checks are added, never removed, renamed, or weakened to make the gate pass.
Results are written by scripts/gate.mjs into evidence/, never by hand.
A piece is done only when every required check for it passed in the latest gate run AND its repro check re-derived the published headline numbers from committed data.
kind = unit (vitest suites) | repro (re-derive published numbers from committed snapshot, diff bit-for-bit) | audit (independent cross-check of a number against raw tool output).

checks.note: safeFetch guard incl. timeout + byte cap, model policy, cost accounting vs a real OH usage line, Wilson known answers, headline refusal, gateway mock-mode + spend cap, HMAC redaction, PII sweep
imported suite; upstream count at import was 172

protocol hash, textify determinism, markdown helpers, L0 milestone/time goldens on own-authored fixtures, install extraction, syntax parsers, L1 checks with a fake lookup, candidate ordering + exclusions, snapshot helpers
after seeding: protocol hash in run-state.json equals the committed protocol files hash, and the protocol commit predates seededAt (git). Passes trivially before seeding.
re-derives findings.json + run-meta.json from the committed snapshot + lookup cache with the network off; must match bit-for-bit. Fails until the run exists.
no secrets or personal data in committed corpus/data files (text, manifests, caches).
README Result section equals the generator output from run-meta.json verbatim; no hand-typed numbers.
